mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% over a 2-month window triggers a preemptive equity risk premium, pushing S&P 500 forward returns positive in the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: preemptive inflation surprise in a steady interest rate environment
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 60-day rolling mean (t-test p > 0.05) during triggered inflation spikes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly PAYEMS labor cost index above the prior quarter's median increases wage growth expectations, which elevates S&P 500 forward returns by 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > Q1 median for three consecutive months
regime_hint: labor cost acceleration in a stable employment regime
failure_condition: During triggered labor-cost acceleration, 20-day forward returns are negative or flat, and the 20-day return is not statistically above the 5-day pre-trigger mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO supply index above 102.0 signals a resilient manufacturing sector, which reduces near-term idiosyncratic risk and produces a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: Over 100 observed INDPRO months above 102.0, 60-day forward returns remain negative or flat on average, and the IC is below -0.05 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly rise in HOUST retail sales exceeding 2% over 3 months indicates strengthening consumer demand, which elevates equity risk premia and drives positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST grows > 2% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: During triggered demand surge, 20-day forward returns are negative, and the 20-day return is not statistically higher than the 20-day mean of the prior 30 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4.25% for two consecutive months, the tightening bias increases discount rates, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
regime_hint: early stage of a tightening cycle
failure_condition: During triggered FEDFUNDS hikes, 60-day forward returns are not significantly worse than the 60-day pre-hike mean (t-test p > 0.05), or the IC is above 0.03 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE below 5.5% for two consecutive months during a low-employment regime increases the perceived labor market slack, which elevates equity valuations and yields positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5.5 for two consecutive months and UNRATE < 6.0 in prior month
regime_hint: labor market slackening in a contractionary phase
failure_condition: During triggered low-rate environment, 20-day forward returns are flat or negative, and the IC is below -0.03 over the 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both RSAFS industrial demand and INDPRO manufacturing output by at least 2% in the same month indicate sector-specific softness, which amplifies perceived idiosyncratic risk and drives negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < INDPRO_prev_month - 2% AND INDPRO < INDPRO_prev_month - 2% in same month
regime_hint: sector-specific softness in a mature economy
failure_condition: During triggered interaction, 60-day forward returns are not worse than the 60-day rolling mean (t-test p > 0.05), or the IC exceeds 0.05 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in GDPC1 GDP growth (quarter-on-quarter) by more than 1.5% for three consecutive quarters in a steady inflation environment is interpreted as a loss of momentum, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < GDPC1_prev_quarter - 1.5% for three consecutive quarters
regime_hint: late-cycle deceleration in a stable inflation regime
failure_condition: During triggered deceleration, 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the 20-day mean of the prior 12 months (t-test p > 0.05), or the IC is above 0.03 over the window.
